about_the_game:
Guardian Demon is an action packed arcade style game. Utilizing simple controls making it easy for anyone to pick up and play but with enough depth to encourage honing your skills and reaching for a spot at the top of the leaderboard to show your mastery of the mechanics.

Love some good old fashion carnage? Well you've got your work cut out for you. Take on the role of a demonic sword and protect the feeble peasant Myson from the endless onslaught of orcs out for blood! Guard Myson from magic and arrows with your impenetrable shield form and strike back with your sharp and deadly sword form. Gather blood from each kill to build up your blood meter and unleash your ultimate form. Compete with other players to see who can last the longest and take your place on the leaderboard. Use gold to customize Myson with additional palettes.

Credits:

Music Composed by Felipe Rodriguez

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 110 MB available space

short_description: Protect the helpless peasant Myson from an army of angry orcs for as long as possible in this action arcade game. Defeat hordes of orcs with simple and easy to learn intuitive controls, earn gold to customize Myson's appearance and compete with others to see who can survive the longest!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian
